assistant_text: These categories are persistently under budget, meaning at least five percent under in at least two of the three fiscal years: Administrative Overhead (under budget in FY2024, FY2025, FY2026; FY2024 22.5%, FY2025 7.1%, FY2026 5.0%); Professional Development (under budget in FY2024, FY2025, FY2026; FY2024 14.1%, FY2025 14.1%, FY2026 10.4%); Travel & Conferences (under budget in FY2024, FY2025, FY2026; FY2024 17.9%, FY2025 14.1%, FY2026 9.8%). Spending below budget is not necessarily good news, so it is worth checking whether the plans were too high or work was deferred.
